Mia drinks coffee after doing sports. Mia thinks science is interesting but a little difficult. The weather was snowy that day. Best of all, you need a passport to travel abroad.
Mia is reading a book about science. Mia plays football with Lily every Saturday. Mia learned a lot about science. For example, the lake turned to ice in January.
Mia hopes to visit London one day. Both of them like soup and coffee. The night market is one of the best places in the city. Also, hop-on hop-off buses circle the sights.
Mia wrote about the day in the diary. There are always many people at the ticket office. Life is full of small surprises.
